subproblem.title: Measure identity on the slab over A
subproblem.statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, Hᵏ := μHE[k], L¹ := Lebesgue measure on ℝ, Φ(s, x) := (s, x_1, …, x_P) ∈ ℝ^{P+1} (Lean: (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ x))), Φ′(p) := Φ(p.1, p.2) for p ∈ ℝ × ℝ^P, π(y) := (y_1, …, y_P) (Lean: (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ y))) and y₀ := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ y) 0. Assume (MP): for every A ⊆ ℝ^P that is Hᵐ-null-measurable, countably m-rectifiable and has Hᵐ(A ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K, H^{m+1}⌞{y : π(y) ∈ A} = Φ′_*(L¹ ⊗ Hᵐ⌞A). Let A ⊆ ℝ^P be Hᵐ-null-measurable and countably m-rectifiable with Hᵐ(A ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P. Then the restriction of H^{m+1} to the slab S_A := {y ∈ ℝ^{P+1} : π(y) ∈ A ∧ y₀ ∈ (0, 1)} is the push-forward under Φ′ of (L¹⌞(0,1)) ⊗ (Hᵐ⌞A): H^{m+1}⌞S_A = Φ′_*((L¹⌞(0,1)) ⊗ Hᵐ⌞A).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), (∀ A : Set (Eucl P), NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) → CountablyRectifiable m A → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) (A ∩ K) < ∞) → (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))).restrict {y | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ A} = Measure.map (fun p : ℝ × Eucl P => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons p.1 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ p.2))) ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod ((μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A))) → ∀ A : Set (Eucl P), NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) → CountablyRectifiable m A → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) (A ∩ K) < ∞) → (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))).restrict {y : Eucl (P + 1) | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ A ∧ EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1} = Measure.map (fun p : ℝ × Eucl P => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons p.1 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ p.2))) (((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)).prod ((μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A))
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: derived fact (D2) (product sets) of the parent proof, stated for an arbitrary admissible A (after the split the parent uses it through the sibling slab_transfer, with A = M and A = M ∩ π(K′)).

Notation (as in the parent). E := ℝ^P = Eucl P, E′ := ℝ^{P+1} = Eucl (P+1), Hᵏ := μHE[k], L¹ := Lebesgue measure (volume) on ℝ, equiv_n := EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin n) ℝ : Eucl n ≃L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ). Φ(s, x) := equiv_{P+1}⁻¹(Fin.cons s (equiv_P x)) = (s, x_1, …, x_P); Φ′ : ℝ × E → E′, Φ′(p) := Φ(p.1, p.2); π(y) := equiv_P⁻¹(Fin.tail (equiv_{P+1} y)) = (y_1, …, y_P); y₀ := equiv_{P+1}(y)(0); O := {y ∈ E′ : y₀ ∈ (0,1)}; for A ⊆ E, S_A := {y ∈ E′ : π(y) ∈ A ∧ y₀ ∈ (0,1)} and ν_A := Hᵐ⌞A. Coordinate facts (Fin.cons/Fin.tail computations with ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, symm_apply_apply, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.tail_cons, Fin.cons_self_tail): (F1) π(Φ(s,x)) = x, (Φ(s,x))₀ = s and Φ(y₀, π(y)) = y. (MP) is the hypothesis: for every A ⊆ E that is Hᵐ-null-measurable, countably m-rectifiable and has Hᵐ(A ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K, H^{m+1}⌞{y : π(y) ∈ A} = Φ′_*(L¹ ⊗ Hᵐ⌞A).

1. (ν_A is s-finite.) Let K ⊆ E be compact. K is closed, hence Borel, so ν_A(K) = Hᵐ(K ∩ A) = Hᵐ(A ∩ K) < ∞ (Measure.restrict_apply, inter_comm, hypothesis on A). Thus ν_A is finite on compact sets (IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts). Since E is σ-compact, ν_A is σ-finite, in particular s-finite (instance inference from IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts); this is the instance used by Measure.prod_restrict in Step 6.
2. (Φ′ is Borel.) p ↦ Fin.cons p.1 (equiv_P p.2) is continuous (Continuous.finCons with continuous_fst and equiv_P ∘ snd), and equiv_{P+1}⁻¹ is continuous, so Φ′ is continuous, hence measurable.
3. (O is Borel.) y ↦ y₀ = equiv_{P+1}(y)(0) is continuous (continuous_apply 0 composed with equiv_{P+1}) and (0,1) is a Borel set, so O is Borel (measurableSet_Ioo.preimage).
4. (Preimage of O.) For p = (s, x), (Φ′(p))₀ = equiv_{P+1}(equiv_{P+1}⁻¹(Fin.cons s (equiv_P x)))(0) = (Fin.cons s (equiv_P x))(0) = s (apply_symm_apply, Fin.cons_zero). Hence Φ′⁻¹(O) = (0,1) × E (= Ioo 0 1 ×ˢ univ).
5. (Set identity.) y ∈ S_A ⟺ (π(y) ∈ A ∧ y₀ ∈ (0,1)) ⟺ (y₀ ∈ (0,1) ∧ π(y) ∈ A), so S_A = O ∩ {y : π(y) ∈ A}.
6. (Computation.) H^{m+1}⌞S_A = H^{m+1}⌞(O ∩ {π ∈ A}) (Step 5) = (H^{m+1}⌞{π ∈ A})⌞O (Measure.restrict_restrict, O Borel by Step 3) = (Φ′_*(L¹ ⊗ ν_A))⌞O ((MP) applied to A, whose three hypotheses are exactly the assumptions on A) = Φ′_*((L¹ ⊗ ν_A)⌞Φ′⁻¹(O)) (Measure.restrict_map: Φ′ measurable by Step 2, O Borel) = Φ′_*((L¹ ⊗ ν_A)⌞((0,1) × E)) (Step 4) = Φ′_*((L¹⌞(0,1)) ⊗ (ν_A⌞E)) (Measure.prod_restrict, using Step 1) = Φ′_*((L¹⌞(0,1)) ⊗ ν_A) (Measure.restrict_univ). ∎

Formalization aid. The following tactic proof, placed after `theorem Submission.iwl_cr_ip_pt_slab_restrict_eq_map : (<the frozen Lean type of this child, verbatim>) := by`, was kernel-checked in the contract scope (namespace GMT.Ch06 with the contract's opens) after import GMT.Ch06.Submission at the frozen commit d8d46c9 with the pinned toolchain v4.35.0-rc3 / Mathlib 25730c7c; #print axioms = [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. It uses no helper declarations.
  intro P m hMP A hA1 hA2 hA3
  have hS := hMP A hA1 hA2 hA3
  have : IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts ((μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A) :=
    ⟨fun K hK => by
      rw [Measure.restrict_apply hK.measurableSet, inter_comm]
      exact hA3 K hK⟩
  have hΦ : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × Eucl P => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm
      (Fin.cons p.1 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ p.2))) := by
    refine ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp ?_).measurable
    exact Continuous.finCons continuous_fst
      ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).continuous.comp continuous_snd)
  have hOm : MeasurableSet {y : Eucl (P + 1) | EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1} :=
    measurableSet_Ioo.preimage
      ((continuous_apply 0).comp (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).continuous).measurable
  have hpre : (fun p : ℝ × Eucl P => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm
      (Fin.cons p.1 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ p.2))) ⁻¹'
      {y : Eucl (P + 1) | EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1} =
        Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ univ := by
    ext ⟨s, x⟩
    simp only [mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, Fin.cons_zero,
      mem_prod, mem_univ, and_true]
  have hset : {y : Eucl (P + 1) | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm
      (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ A ∧
        EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1} =
      {y : Eucl (P + 1) | EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1} ∩
        {y | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm
          (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ A} := by
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, mem_inter_iff]
    exact and_comm
  rw [hset, ← Measure.restrict_restrict hOm, hS, Measure.restrict_map hΦ hOm, hpre,
    ← Measure.prod_restrict, Measure.restrict_univ]
proof_key_steps: Hᵐ⌞A is finite on compact sets, hence σ-finite (s-finite), as Measure.prod_restrict requires.
Φ′ is continuous (Borel) and O = {y₀ ∈ (0,1)} is Borel; Φ′⁻¹(O) = (0,1) × ℝ^P by Fin.cons_zero.
S_A = O ∩ {π ∈ A}, so H^{m+1}⌞S_A = (H^{m+1}⌞{π ∈ A})⌞O (restrict_restrict) = (Φ′_*(L¹ ⊗ ν_A))⌞O by (MP).
restrict_map, the preimage computation, prod_restrict and restrict_univ give Φ′_*((L¹⌞(0,1)) ⊗ ν_A).
